author: Ariel Lee
purpose: Presentation architecture, visual communication, and information design
language_basis: Nine sources are principally English; the bilingual Grid Systems is represented through its English text. English is the principal substantive language. The user chat language was not used to infer the expert default.
source_policy: User-supplied local sources only. Raw books, full extraction, screenshots and private absolute paths are excluded from this repository.

pdf.filename: resonate PRESENT VISUAL STORIES THAT TRANSFORM AUDIENCES (Nancy Duarte).pdf

sources.coverage: Narrative architecture; nine chapters and coda. Named presentation form, audience/mentor roles, Big Idea, contrast, risk and S.T.A.R. methods retained.
sources.compression_and_omissions: Historical speech transcripts, biographies, image galleries and repeated motivational material compressed; not every sparkline visually inspected.

sources.coverage: All twelve chapter responsibilities mapped; diagram families, data rules, hierarchy, visual system, motion, templates and manifesto retained.
sources.compression_and_omissions: Repeated before/after galleries and software-era production details compressed. Guest advice remains attributed; contradictory slide-count examples are not universal rules.

pdf.filename: Presentation zen  simple ideas on presentation design and delivery (Reynolds, Garr).pdf

sources.coverage: Eleven chapters mapped; preparation, two message questions, three artifacts, slideument critique, restraint, visual design and live delivery retained.
sources.compression_and_omissions: Gallery, guest essays and personal anecdotes selectively compressed; broad brain claims not adopted as scientific findings.

pdf.filename: Grid Systems in Graphic Design - Raster systeme für die visuelle Gestaltung (Josef Müller-Brockmann).pdf

sources.coverage: Twenty-four substantive TOC topics grouped; type/field coupling, construction, 8/20/32-field systems, corporate identity and spatial extensions retained.
sources.compression_and_omissions: Bilingual MD severely corrupted; English-region PDF recovery used. Historical specimen plates, exhibition dimensions and application gallery not exhaustively inspected.

sources.section_basis: Three main parts mapped with detailed operational topics: font selection, spacing, numerals, optical size, hierarchy, inclusion, scripts and serial grids.

pdf.filename: Thinking with Type A Critical Guide for Designers, Writers, Editors, and Students (Third Revised and Expanded Edition) (Ellen Lupton).pdf

sources.coverage: Three main parts mapped with detailed operational topics: font selection, spacing, numerals, optical size, hierarchy, inclusion, scripts and serial grids.
sources.compression_and_omissions: Detailed type history, drawing exercises and comprehensive treatment of each script omitted. Chinese and distance-reading examples checked; no claim of comprehensive multilingual expertise.

sources.section_basis: Sixteen top-level contents entries counted including supporting back matter

pdf.filename: The non-designers design book  design and topographic principles for the visual novice (Williams, Robin, 1953- author).pdf

sources.coverage: Sixteen top-level contents entries counted including supporting back matter; CRAP, concord/conflict/contrast, six categories and six type contrasts retained.
sources.compression_and_omissions: Color, punctuation and practical gallery compressed and explicitly marked. Quiz answers, specimen catalog and promotional material omitted. Strong beginner pairing doctrine preserved as a source claim.

sources.section_basis: Nine method chapters plus eight profile sections mapped

pdf.filename: The functional art  an introduction to information graphics and visualization (Cairo, Alberto, 1974- author).pdf

sources.coverage: Nine method chapters plus eight profile sections mapped; function/form, Visualization Wheel, perception, design and interaction frameworks retained.
sources.compression_and_omissions: Profiles recorded as a group with attribution boundaries, not reconstructed from their headings. Cognitive claims are historical exposition, not current verification.

sources.coverage: All six chapters mapped; micro/macro, layers, small multiples, color functions and space-time relations retained.
sources.compression_and_omissions: Many historical image details cannot be recovered from MD alone. Selected PDF images inspected; no general claim of full gallery inspection.

sources.section_basis: Nine argumentative blocks used for a short unchaptered essay

pdf.filename: The cognitive style of PowerPoint  pitching out corrupts within (Tufte, Edward R., 1942-).pdf

sources.coverage: Nine argumentative blocks used for a short unchaptered essay; cognitive style, fragmentation, Columbia analysis, evidence comparison and handout alternative retained.
sources.compression_and_omissions: Supplied filename suggests a later subtitle, but internal title/copyright establish the 2003 essay. Later expanded-edition material is not claimed. Statistical polemic treated critically.

sources.coverage: Ten chapters mapped; context, chart choice, declutter, attention, design, story and case applications retained; six-step method and source boundaries retained.
sources.compression_and_omissions: Repeated worked examples compressed. Title verified as Storytelling with Data; Storytelling with You not blended in. No causal inference from visual emphasis.
